definitions.gloss: city center, downtown, heart of the city
definitions.explanation: The central area of a city, particularly a major metropolitan area. Often refers specifically to central Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {都心|としん}のマンションは{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Apartments in the city center are expensive.

examples.japanese: {都心|としん}から{郊外|こうがい}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した。
examples.english: I moved from downtown to the suburbs.

examples.japanese: {都心|としん}{回帰|かいき}の{傾向|けいこう}が{見|み}られる。
examples.english: A trend of returning to the city center can be seen.
examples.notes: 都心回帰 = return to city center living

notes:
USAGE: {都心|としん} is commonly used to refer to the central area of Tokyo, but can apply to other major cities as well.

TOKYO SPECIFIC:
- {都心|としん}3{区|く} - Chiyoda, Chuo, Minato (the three central wards)
- {副|ふく}{都心|としん} - sub-centers like Shinjuku, Shibuya, Ikebukuro

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都心|としん}の{地価|ちか} (city center land prices)
- {都心|としん}{回帰|かいき} (return to city center)
- {都心|としん}{部|ぶ} (central urban area)

CONTRAST:
- {都心|としん} (city center)
- {郊外|こうがい} (suburbs)
- {地方|ちほう} (rural areas/provinces)
